quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: Put two fingers on your throat: 'bin' should make it buzz right away, while 'pin' stays silent until the vowel starts.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "bin." Your vocal cords vibrate from the very start of the /b/. "Pin" would start voiceless, with a small puff of air before the vowel.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /p/ and /b/ are made the same way, with the lips. /p/ has no voice and a puff of air; /b/ is voiced, with the vocal cords buzzing from the start.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.

quests.explanation: The speaker said "pat." The /p/ is voiceless - no vibration, just a light puff of air. "Bat" would start with the vocal cords buzzing immediately.
quests.vowelTensionRule: Both sounds close the lips completely. The difference is voicing: /p/ stays silent until it releases, while /b/ hums with the voice immediately.
